mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y GDPC1 growth accelerates by >1pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM Manufacturing Index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50, indicating a contraction in manufacturing activity, it predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the slowing industrial sector weighs on the broader economy.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 50 but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as the UNRATE rising by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous 3 months, signals a rapidly weakening labor market and predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When both housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) are in year-over-year decline, it signals a broad-based weakening of consumer demand that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y HOUST and RSAFS both declining but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 6% and rising, and the ISM Manufacturing Index (INDPRO) is below 50 and falling, it signals a severe economic downturn that will drive sharply negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 6% and falling, INDPRO < 50 and falling, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3% and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy in response to high inflation that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 3% and FEDFUNDS rising, but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year growth rate of payroll employment (PAYEMS) exceeds 2%, it signals a strong labor market and robust consumer demand that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y PAYEMS growth > 2% but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.
